description.raw: As a:  MRD I want to:  select the status of an account So that I can:  track the lifecycle of Accounts in line with business and reporting needs Scenario: Configure Account Status values Given I am a MRD When I need to select the status of an account Then the values must exist in this exact order: New Prospect Onboarding Contracted Active Runoff Offboarded And the field must be available on all Account record types And the field must be auditable in history tracking
